description: This Java class 'LogView' extends TextView and implements LogNode to provide a UI component for displaying log messages received through the LogNode interface. It formats log data and appends it to its display, supporting chained log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages received through the LogNode interface, formatting log entries and supporting chaining of log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats incoming log data (priority, tag, message, exception) into a string and appends it to the log display, ensuring thread-safe UI updates. Also forwards log messages to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
